name: Alpha Hole Prison
source:
Earthling Miguel Sanchez has been sentenced to life at Alpha Hole, a notorious space prison. His survival depends on using his charms to convince a powerful ally to protect him.

[From [url=https://ypressgames.itch.io/alpha-hole-prison-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
地球人米格尔·桑切斯被判在臭名昭著的太空监狱“阿尔法洞”终身监禁。能否活下来，取决于他能否凭借魅力，说服一位强大的盟友保护自己。

[摘自[url=https://ypressgames.itch.io/alpha-hole-prison-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
